name: Balance
tagline: Give your work a clear rhythm with focus timers, planned breaks, and session tracking.
description:
Balance is a focus and time-tracking app for Mac built around Pomodoro-style work sessions. It gives a task or study period a visible boundary, records completed focus time, and helps turn an intention to work into a small, measurable session.

Start a timer when you begin a task, take a planned break when it ends, and use the record of sessions to understand how time was spent. This is useful for study, deep work, or personal projects where a simple rhythm is more helpful than a full project-management system.

## Features

- Run focus and break intervals using a Pomodoro-style timer.
- Track completed focus sessions and review time spent on work or study.
- Use a Mac-focused productivity interface without introducing a large task-management hierarchy.
- Extend the basic timer workflow through the current in-app purchase options if they fit the chosen setup.

## Where it fits

Balance fits people who want a straightforward time boundary and record of attention on a Mac. It works alongside a separate task list, calendar, or paper plan.

It does not automatically protect attention from websites or apps. People who need strict blocking, cross-device coordination, or detailed planning may need a broader focus tool.

## Privacy and requirements

Balance requires macOS 14 or later and can use iCloud to keep its current session data in sync. The App Store privacy label says purchase history and an identifier may be collected without being linked to the user. Notifications are needed for timely break and clock-out reminders; any calendar or Focus-mode connection should be enabled only when it supports the intended routine.

## Pricing

Balance includes a free tier. Pro $4.99/month, $49.99/year, or $149.99 lifetime.
